AIR 87 Sayali shares why September to December is one of the most crucial phases for UPSC CSE 2027 aspirants. 

While many aspirants slow down after Prelims, this is the time to strengthen your UPSC Mains preparation, answer writing and GS/Optional coverage and work towards becoming Mains-ready before the Prelims phase begins.
If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, this is an important reminder to use the next few months strategically.
